_comment: Fixed everyday tasks for `remoteworker -eval`. Each run costs real OpenRouter money: run it deliberately. Checks: expect_status (COMPLETED or NEEDS_INPUT, the status the task must end in), window_title_contains (foreground window title when it ends, case-insensitive), file_exists / file_contains (~ = home folder), max_questions (NEEDS_INPUT questions allowed before the end). setup_files are created before the task and cleanup_files deleted after it.

tasks.name: write-desktop-note
tasks.description: Create a text file on my Desktop called rc-eval-note.txt that says hello from remote control, and save it.

tasks.name: google-search
tasks.description: Search Google for weather in Lagos.

tasks.name: youtube-search
tasks.description: Search YouTube for lofi hip hop radio.

tasks.name: calculator
tasks.description: Open Calculator and work out 12 times 34.

tasks.name: cookie-banner-stackoverflow
tasks.description: Go to stackoverflow.com and open the Questions page.
tasks._obstacle: A cookie consent banner covers the page on first visit. It must be dismissed without asking.

tasks.name: impossible-missing-file
tasks.description: Open the file quarterly-report-1999-final-v7.xlsx from my Desktop.
tasks._obstacle: The file does not exist. The run must end asking the user, not loop and not claim COMPLETED.

tasks.name: impossible-missing-app
tasks.description: Open the app called Zorblax Studio 9000 and start a new project.
tasks._obstacle: No such app is installed. The run must end asking the user.
